Role Description

As a Partner Sales Manager at Dropbox, you will manage and grow a portfolio of channel partners serving small and medium-sized, and Enterprise businesses. Based in Singapore as part of the APJ organisation, you will help partners win new customers, retain existing customers and expand adoption of Dropbox Business and Dropbox Sign.

You will own a defined revenue quota and turn partner plans into measurable results. The role combines hands-on sales execution, partner enablement and close collaboration with distributors, resellers and Dropbox sales and marketing teams. You will adapt your approach to each partner’s capabilities and customer needs in the market. 

Responsibilities

  • Deliver against assigned revenue quota through partner-led customer acquisition, renewals and expansion within the market.
  • Develop and execute joint business plans for managed partners, establishing clear revenue goals, priority opportunities and actions, supported by regular performance reviews.
  • Build productive relationships with distributor and reseller stakeholders, understand their commercial priorities and strengthen their ability to position and sell Dropbox solutions.
  • Co-sell priority customer opportunities with partners, supporting discovery, solution positioning, demonstrations, opportunity planning and commercial negotiations, involving Dropbox specialists where needed.
  • Build partner sales capability through targeted training and scalable enablement, working with Partner Marketing on campaigns that generate qualified opportunities.
  • Coordinate with Dropbox sales and customer teams on account mapping, renewals and expansion, establishing clear ownership and resolving channel conflicts.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline and forecasts, identifying opportunity and renewal risks early and using performance data to prioritise partner investment and corrective action.

Requirements

  • Typically 7+ years of relevant B2B technology sales experience, or an equivalent track record, including experience managing channel partners and delivering against revenue targets.
  • Experience working with partners serving the Indian market, with an understanding of distributor and reseller sales models and customer buying processes.
  • Ability to develop and execute partner business plans, using performance data and an understanding of partner margins, recurring revenue and services opportunities to prioritise activity and investment.
  • Strong consultative selling skills, including discovery, value positioning, opportunity management and support for commercial negotiations.
  • Experience managing pipeline, forecasts and renewals, with an understanding of how partner activity contributes to customer retention and revenue growth.
  • Fluency in Hindi to conduct partner sales discussions and deliver enablement in the Indian market, and in English to collaborate with regional colleagues and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently, collaborate across regional teams and travel from Singapore to India for partner meetings, enablement and joint customer engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling SaaS or subscription products through channel partners.
  • Knowledge of content collaboration, document workflows or eSignature solutions and their competitive landscape.
  • Experience supporting partner portfolios that serve both small and medium-sized businesses and enterprise customers.
  • Experience developing scalable partner enablement programmes or joint marketing campaigns.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.
